title: fix: stream request bodies to the generation coordinator (>32 MiB uploads)
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Generation coordination now sends request bodies as flow-controlled RPC streams instead of serializing them inside the job argument, removing the 32 MiB RPC limit that caused large uploads to fail with a 503 before reaching the provider. The coordinator stores streamed bodies in its existing 1 MB chunks; duplicate callers and cache hits cancel their unused streams, while one owner handles each cache identity. This covers large voice-isolator, voice-changer, stem-separation, transcription, and /v1/images/edits requests. The storage format is unchanged and requires no migration. Tests exercise a 40 MiB upload through the real coordinator RPC and a concurrent 38 MiB voice-isolator request end to end.
